blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Use differentials to approximate the value of: \(\sqrt{26}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh "differentials se andaza" wala sawal hai: \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\).
Function \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\). 26 ke sab se qareeb perfect square 25 hai, jahan \(\sqrt{25} = 5\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\sqrt{26}\) ki takreebi value.
Plan: \(x = 25\), \(dx = 1\), \(dy\) nikal kar 5 mein jor dena.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sqrt{26}\).
Maloom karna: is ki takreebi value.
Tareeqa: \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\), \(x = 25\), \(dx = \Delta x = 26 - 25 = 1\); \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\).

\(x = 25\) par differential
\[dy = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{25}}(1) = \dfrac{1}{10} = 0.1\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{25} = 5\), to \(2 \times 5 = 10\). Yeh chhota sa correction hai jo 5 mein jorna hai.

Andaza
\[\sqrt{26} = f(25 + 1) \approx f(25) + dy\]
\[= 5 + 0.1 = 5.1\]
Kyun: maloom value jama correction.

Tasdeeq
Calculator: \(\sqrt{26} = 5.09902\); farq sirf takreeban \(0.001\). Aur \(5.1^{2} = 26.01\), jo 26 ke bohat qareeb hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Use differentials to approximate the value of: \((33)^{1/5}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan fifth root (paanchwa jazr) hai. Function \(f(x) = x^{1/5}\).
33 ke qareeb aisa number chahiye jis ka fifth root exact ho: \(2^{5} = 32\).
Find kya karna hai? \((33)^{1/5}\) ki takreebi value.
Plan: \(x = 32\), \(dx = 1\), \(dy\) nikal kar 2 mein jorna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \((33)^{1/5}\).
Maloom karna: is ki takreebi value.
Tareeqa: \(f(x) = x^{1/5}\), \(x = 32\), \(dx = 33 - 32 = 1\); \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\).

\(x = 32\) par differential
\[32^{4/5} = (32^{1/5})^{4} = 2^{4} = 16\]
\[dy = \dfrac{1}{5(16)}(1) = \dfrac{1}{80} = 0.0125\]
Kyun: pehle fifth root (2), phir power 4 (16). Is tarah bara number banaye baghair hisaab ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
Calculator: \((33)^{1/5} = 2.01235\); teen decimal places tak bilkul sahi.

blocks.prompt: 3 (iii) Use differentials to approximate the value of: \(\tan 46^\circ\)
blocks.explanation:
Function \(f(x) = \tan x\).
\(46^\circ\) ke qareeb aasaan angle \(45^\circ\) hai, jahan \(\tan 45^\circ = 1\).
\(dx = 1^\circ\), jo radians mein \(\frac{\pi}{180}\) hai.
Plan: \(45^\circ\) par \(dy = \sec^{2}x\,dx\), phir 1 mein jorna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\tan 46^\circ\).
Maloom karna: is ki takreebi value.
Tareeqa: \(f(x) = \tan x\), \(x = 45^\circ\), \(dx = 1^\circ = \frac{\pi}{180}\); \(f(x + \Delta x) \approx f(x) + dy\).

Differential
\[dy = 2\left(\dfrac{\pi}{180}\right) = \dfrac{\pi}{90}\]
\[\approx 0.0349\]
Kyun: \(dx\) radians mein hona zaroori hai.
Dhyan dein: \(dx = 1\) rakhne se \(\tan 46^\circ \approx 3\) aata, jo bilkul ghalat hai.

Andaza
\[\tan 46^\circ \approx \tan 45^\circ + dy\]
\[= 1 + 0.0349 = 1.0349\]
Kyun: maloom value 1 jama correction.
